avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces fentanyl levels; P-glycoprotein inducer increases efflux
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated. Risk of reduced analgesia and breakthrough pain. Do not use concurrently.

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases fentanyl bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely. Risk of profound sedation, respiratory depression, and overdose.

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CNS depressant; potential CYP3A4 interactions; hepatotoxicity risk compounds opioid metabolic burden
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated. Increased respiratory depression and sedation risk.

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CNS depressant potentiates opioid effects; may inhibit CYP3A4
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use. Risk of excessive sedation and respiratory compromise.

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibitor may modestly increase fentanyl levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased opioid effects (drowsiness, dizziness). Dose adjustment may be needed.

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition; antiemetic effect may mask opioid-induced nausea warning signs
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution. Monitor for efficacy changes; document concurrent use.

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric (Curcumin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 inhibition at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe at typical dietary doses. Monitor if high-dose supplementation used.

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance opioid receptor sensitivity and CNS depression at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use at RDA levels only (320-420 mg/day). Avoid megadosing.

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases fentanyl bioavailability (up to 2-3 fold)
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid. Risk of severe respiratory depression, overdose, and death.

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases fentanyl plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or limit intake. Monitor closely if consumed; report any increased sedation.

avoid_foods.name: Seville Oranges (and marmalade)
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; stronger effect than regular oranges
avoid_foods.action: Contraindicated. Avoid products containing Seville orange extract.

caution_foods.name: Starfruit
caution_foods.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition; minimal clinical significance but documented interaction potential
caution_foods.action: Occasional consumption acceptable; avoid frequent or large quantities.

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase transmucosal fentanyl absorption and variability; affects GI transit
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary fat intake. Instruct patient on standardized meal timing with transdermal/buccal forms.

caution_foods.name: Cranberry Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 interaction; limited clinical evidence
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake acceptable; monitor for any unusual opioid effects.

monitoring_notes: Fentanyl is a high-risk opioid with narrow therapeutic window metabolized primarily by CYP3A4; any inhibition significantly increases overdose risk. Educate patients to report all supplements, herbal products, and dietary changes; counsel specifically on absolute avoidance of grapefruit/pomegranate and St. John's Wort to prevent dangerous interactions or loss of analgesia.
